title: Governance-Aware Federated Learning for Multi-Agent AI Systems: A Policy-Driven Framework for Trustworthy Collaborative AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.38411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exchanging raw data, but conventional FL provides limited runtime governance, evidence verification, fairness assessment, explainability monitoring, and auditability. This paper proposes Governance-Aware Federated Learning (GAFL), which combines independent governance-evidence verification, temporal trust, fairness and explanation assessment, anomaly detection, policy enforcement, normalized aggregation, and tamper-evident audit logging. Client-reported governance values are authenticated, bound to their submitted model updates, and independently recomputed before aggregation. A cross-silo prototype with 10 participants was evaluated on the Adult Income dataset under honest, benign non-IID, biased-data, malicious-update, non-compliant, falsified-evidence, and mixed-threat scenarios. translated_title: 面向多智能体AI系统的治理感知联邦学习：一种政策驱动的可信协作AI框架
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使各方能够在不交换原始数据的情况下进行协作模型训练，但传统联邦学习在运行时治理、证据验证、公平性评估、可解释性监控和可审计性方面提供的支持有限。本文提出了治理感知联邦学习（GAFL），它结合了独立的治理证据验证、时间信任、公平性与解释性评估、异常检测、政策执行、归一化聚合以及防篡改审计日志。客户端上报的治理值需经过身份验证，与其提交的模型更新相绑定，并在聚合前进行独立重新计算。研究构建了一个包含10个参与方的跨机构原型系统，在Adult Income数据集上，于诚实、良性非独立同分布、数据偏差、恶意更新、不合规、伪造证据以及混合威胁等多种场景下进行了评估，并在五个随机种子下比较了四种方法：FedAvg、带异常过滤的FedAvg等。
tldr: 提出治理感知联邦学习（GAFL）框架，通过独立治理证据验证、时间信任、公平性与解释性评估、异常检测、政策执行和防篡改审计日志，为联邦学习提供运行时可审计、可执行政策的可信治理能力，在多种威胁场景下显著增强协作AI的可信性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Governance-Aware Federated Learning (GAFL), a policy-driven framework that combines independent governance-evidence verification, temporal trust, fairness and explanation assessment, anomaly detection, policy enforcement, and tamper-evident audit logging to enable trustworthy, auditable collaborative AI under diverse threat scenarios.
